name: Phaidei Xúnmi
source:
Having completed the Amphoreus cycle, Phainon reaches the end of the re-creation. His former companions are all revived. However, the one person he most wishes to see—Mydei—has yet to appear.
Upon investigation, he learns that due to the Soul Sundering ritual and excessive deaths in previous cycles, Mydei's soul has been lost in the data stream, shattered into fragments.
To recover his beloved, Phainon once again plunges into another cycle, solely to gather all the fragments of Mydei.
translation:
走完翁法罗斯的轮回后，白厄抵达了再创世的终点，昔日的伙伴们尽数复活。然而，他最渴望见到的那个人——万敌，却迟迟没有现身。
几经探查，他才得知由于过往轮回中的裂魂仪式与太多次死亡，万敌的灵魂已迷失在数据洪流之中，碎裂成了无数残片。
为了找回挚爱，白厄毅然再度纵身跃入新的轮回，只为集齐万敌散落的所有灵魂碎片。
